review_type: Independent source-grounded reader and static lifecycle review

reader_understanding.scope: Retain SPEC-006/007's repository-owned specification skill and reviewed immutable copies in new planning projects. This is not a policy for every future skill or a general ban on global installation.
reader_understanding.historical_support: SPEC-006 explicitly chooses repository version control and reviewed PRs with no user-wide installation. SPEC-007 requires the complete specification skill and assets from a reviewed immutable revision, provenance, project-owned output, explicit reviewed updates and no synchronization. Their acceptance documents record PR #16/#18 merges and outstanding supported-client checks. bootstrap-project.py confirms the exact Git-object allowlist, full commit SHA requirement and output hashes; it does not verify owner approval.
reader_understanding.rationale: The three alternatives and associated tradeoffs are explicitly present analysis, not reconstructed historical owner deliberation. The proposal does not retrospectively expand prior approvals.
reader_understanding.applicability: The existing SPEC-006/007 implementation remains independently approved. ADR-0001 is Proposed with null decision date and approval reference; Daniel's disposition of its exact framing remains unavailable.
reader_understanding.implementation_limits: No downstream implementation, allowlist expansion, global installation, existing-project synchronization or completion of client acceptance follows from this ADR. Hashes establish bytes, not suitability or review.
reader_understanding.lifecycle: The guide, template and checker consistently distinguish proposal, acceptance/rejection and retirement; retain original acceptance evidence; require reciprocal replacement scopes; permit partial and multi-hop supersession and later deprecated successors; reject unaccepted relationships, missing targets, self-links and cycles. Approval truth, semantic scope and historical editorial preservation remain explicitly human review responsibilities.

limitations: Static source review only; no tests, bootstrap code or document commands executed.
No network access or independent GitHub verification; historical merges and approval statements assessed against linked local acceptance records.
No owner approval inferred or supplied; this review does not satisfy the outstanding final owner disposition.
